scope: Why a bounded rendered guideway clearance is needed near Main Street: the retained raw GTFS alignments themselves cross coarse City building extrusions. This is a source-conflict diagnosis, not proof of the final rendering correction.

method.sourceGeometry: Unmodified raw GTFS directed polylines, sampled every0.5m in their first/last250m near Main Street; no runtime Hermite, Catmull or station-lead interpolation is used for XZ.
method.vertical: Rail height linearly interpolates the actual terrain-derived station stop elevations; passenger eye is2.6m above rail.
method.buildingExtrusions: Exact projected source polygons including holes, shared structure foundation at the first structure polygon-centre City elevation minus0.4m, and source minHeight/height, matching createBuildingBodies before any runtime render carve.
method.finding: Both raw directed GTFS lines intersect source City buildingId133436, feature166039-cut1 and163974, at passenger eye height. The same features intersect the runtime occupied carriage; this overlap is not introduced by the new straight station lead or quintic joins.
method.interpretation: The source records provide coarse historic building massing and representative transit geometry. A local guideway opening can reconcile those records; this does not establish the architectural dimensions of a real-world tunnel or station.

rows.method: Unmodified retained GTFS polyline interpolated every0.5m; railY linearly interpolates the actual runtime station stop railY, plus2.6m eye height. First/last250m nearMain. Exact source polygon containment with holes and createBuildingBodies shared foundation/minHeight/height rules.

properties.reconciliation: City solid clipped against elevated OSM part
